cain-the-market: CAIN’s Monday community meal starts at 3:30 p.m., with sit-down and takeaway options. Meals are limited in quantity and first come, first served; no paperwork, documents or registration are needed.
Every Monday at 3:30 pm , CAIN volunteers serve a meal with the option to either sit down to eat and watch a movie, play games, or enjoy the camaraderie, or take the meal to-go.
Meals are first-come first-served, and limited in quantity. No paperwork, documents or registration needed - just show up!

The Thursday Peace Potluck runs 6–8 p.m., either inside Annette’s House at 4234 Hamilton Avenue or in its front parking lot. CAIN describes the space as wheelchair accessible, but gives no route measurements or entrance details; confirm which location is being used.

Third Way Peace Fellowship offers a free community meal every Thursday from 6:00 pm - 8:00 pm , either inside of Annette's House (4234 Hamilton Ave) or in the front parking lot. The space is wheelchair accessible.

During pantry hours, people experiencing homelessness may request a snack pack. CAIN describes these as quick-meal bags that usually contain shelf-stable, no-cook, individually sized items; contents vary.
During pantry, anyone experiencing homelessness may request a 'snack pack'.
A snack pack is a bag of food meant to provide a quick breakfast or lunch plus a little extra until their next meal.
They usually include shelf-stable, no-cook, individually-sized items like chips, cookies, a sandwich, drinks and more.
